high_level_description: This image depicts the interior of a Puma store, showcasing a display of athletic shoes and their packaging. The setting is well-lit with overhead lighting, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. The shelves are neatly arranged with various Puma products, primarily focusing on running shoes. In the foreground, there are two pairs of shoes displayed on a wooden shelf. One pair is green with white soles, and the other is black with black soles. Both pairs feature the Puma logo prominently on the side. Below these shoes, there are red shoe boxes stacked neatly.
